tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Search Circuit's paid AI agent skills by capability, e.g. 'phishing link', 'token price' or 'summarize a web page'. Returns each skill's id, price in USDG, summary and 30-day usage. Free.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Full details for one skill: input and output schema, a real example, price, 30-day usage, uptime, rating and how to pay for it. Free.

tools.name: try_skill
tools.description: Run a skill once for free on a small input (text up to 500 characters). 3 free calls per day. Paid calls have no such limits.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Workflows that chain several skills (vet a token, install a dependency safely, screen untrusted input and more), with the cost of one run. Free.
